COGNITIVE & SOCIAL NEUROSCIENCE认知与社会神经科学

Understanding social decisions and emotional perception探索社会决策与情绪感知

I am a PhD researcher in psychology at the School of Psychology, South China Normal University, working with Prof. Jun Chen. My research focuses on the cognitive and neural processes involved in social decision-making and emotional perception.

我目前在华南师范大学心理学院攻读心理学博士，导师为陈俊教授。我的研究关注社会决策与情绪感知背后的认知过程和神经机制。

My doctoral research examines how intergroup relations and social norms relate to spontaneous deception. I am particularly interested in how intergroup pressure shapes deceptive choices and the neural processes associated with them.

博士期间，我主要研究群际关系与社会规范对自发欺骗行为的影响，尤其关注群际压力如何影响欺骗决策及其相关神经过程。

Earlier, at Liaoning Normal University, I studied emotional audiovisual processing under the supervision of Prof. Wenbo Luo. This work examined how linguistic and nonlinguistic vocalizations influence the processing of emotional faces and words, as well as how interruptions in sound affect audiovisual integration.

此前，我在辽宁师范大学罗文波教授指导下研究情绪视听加工，探讨语言与非语言声音如何影响情绪面孔和词汇的加工，以及声音中断如何影响视听整合。

Across these research areas, I combine behavioral experiments with electroencephalography and computational modeling. My methods include event-related potentials, time-frequency and representational similarity analyses, EEG microstates, and hierarchical drift-diffusion modeling. I am interested in bringing behavioral and neural measurements together to better understand perception and decision-making.

在这些研究中，我结合行为实验、脑电记录与计算建模，使用事件相关电位、时频分析、表征相似性分析、脑电微状态分析和分层漂移扩散模型等方法，探索如何整合行为与神经数据以理解感知和决策过程。

EEG-informed diffusion modeling of deceptive choice基于脑电与扩散模型的欺骗决策研究

This manuscript examines social-contextual variation in drift rate and theta-linked boundary separation in deceptive choice, using EEG-informed diffusion modeling.本研究结合脑电与扩散模型，考察欺骗决策中社会情境相关的漂移率变化，以及与 theta 活动相关的决策边界。

PSYCHOPHYSIOLOGY · 2025

Vocalization and emotional word recognition声音类型与情绪词识别

How do vocal primes shape emotional word recognition? EEG-based representational similarity analysis showed an early, brief representation of vocalization type, while emotional and semantic features emerged over different time windows.声音启动如何影响情绪词识别？脑电表征相似性分析显示，声音类型在早期短暂表征，而情绪与语义特征出现在不同的时间窗口。

JOURNAL OF COGNITIVE NEUROSCIENCE · 2025

Vocalization and emotional face perception声音类型与情绪面孔感知

How do linguistic and nonlinguistic vocalizations influence emotional face perception? The study found that matching fearful nonlinguistic and happy linguistic vocalizations were associated with faster recognition and differences in early ERP responses.语言与非语言声音如何影响情绪面孔感知？研究发现，与面孔情绪一致的恐惧非语言声音和快乐语言声音分别与更快的识别和早期 ERP 反应差异相关。

BIOLOGICAL PSYCHOLOGY · 2022

Sound gaps and audiovisual integration声音中断与视听整合

Does a brief sound gap affect emotional audiovisual processing under different task demands? P1 responses showed a sound-gap effect for neutral faces in the explicit emotion task and for both emotions in the implicit task.短暂的声音中断如何影响不同任务下的情绪视听加工？P1 结果显示，声音中断效应在显性情绪任务中出现于中性面孔，在隐性任务中则出现于两种情绪条件。
